AI extracts tasks from messages — one click into Q Task
File · image attachments (SHA-256 dedup) + auto KO/EN translation
Realtime via Socket.IO + per-user pinning + edit/delete with audit log
Two-way Project ↔ chat linking + AI candidate dedup

task.name: Q Task — Task execution
task.lead: Assign, review, complete in one flow. 7-state ENUM, 4 perspectives (assignee · reviewer · requester · observer), hours tracking.
bullets: 7 statuses (not_started → waiting → in_progress → reviewing → revision_requested → completed)
Perspective-aware labels (assignee/reviewer/requester/observer) — same task reads differently per role
Hours tracking (estimated · actual · progress%) + capacity dashboard + burndown chart
This week / All mine / Requests — three tabs separating incoming and outgoing
Confirmation workflow (all/any policy) + AI deliverable-based task naming

note.name: Q Note — Voice meetings · memos
note.lead: Deepgram live STT + auto translation + question detection + RAG answer suggestion. Auto summary when meeting ends.
bullets: Deepgram-powered live KO/EN transcription (live + review modes)
Auto question detection — RAG answer suggestions from pre-uploaded materials
Auto vocabulary extraction (verbatim from materials) — improves STT accuracy
Pre-registered speakers + post-matching (no in-meeting modals)
Two-tier model split (gpt-4.1-nano + gpt-4o-mini) for cost efficiency
note.shotAlt: Q note screen — meeting transcript with automatic summary

file.name: Q File — Files
file.lead: Organized per project · per customer. SHA-256 dedup. Two-way Google Drive sync (workspace shared).

1GB / 50GB / 500GB storage and 10MB / 30MB / 50MB per file by plan
External share token links + previews
file.shotAlt: Q file screen — project files organized in per-client folders

bill.name: Q Bill — Billing · payments
bill.lead: Auto sequence quote → contract → invoice → tax invoice. 4 templates (fixed/subscription/consulting/custom) + installment + multi-currency.

Installment billing (invoice_installments) — per-installment payment & tax-invoice marking
5 currencies (KRW/USD/EUR/JPY/CNY) + KR + SWIFT/EN bank info shown together
Native bank-transfer billing as primary + card payment (Stripe) secondary
Tax invoice tracking (KR businesses — issued externally, marked here) + public payment page (token)

servicePage.title:
We design how you work first,
then build the system on top
servicePage.sub: Growth starts with a better operating system, not more tools. We design people, work, information, decisions, AI and systems into one operating system — and then actually build it.
servicePage.by: Work system design and implementation are delivered by WOR-PRO Lab Studio.

why.title: Why design the work system first?
why.p0: When something breaks, most companies buy another program. But most problems start in the operating system, not in the software.
why.p1: If the work itself is unclear, AI adds nothing, automation stalls halfway, and even a great tool ends up unused.
why.p2: A tool will not decide how you work for you.
why.p3: So we design before we build. First we make explicit how the company actually works — then we put the system on top of it.

layers.title: What we design
layers.sub: An operating system has six layers. We design all six together.

structure.name: Business Structure
structure.desc: We start with how the company makes money. We lay out the core work and value chain to find where value is created and where it leaks.
structure.tags: Core work · Value chain · Bottlenecks · Roles

workflow.name: Workflow
workflow.desc: We design so work does not stall when it crosses people. The path from request to completion, approval points, waiting states and handovers become one flow.

information.name: Information
information.desc: We remove the time spent looking for things. Documents, customer data and know-how get a structure: where they accumulate, who takes them out and when.
information.tags: Documents · Customer data · Knowledge · Data flow

decision.name: Decision
decision.desc: Not every decision should land on the founder. We set who decides what and how far, so the system judges instead of a person.

automation.name: Automation
automation.desc: We automate only work that is already clear. Repetitive tasks and data movement go to AI, APIs and workflows, so people are left with judgment.

platform.name: Platform
platform.desc: A design is finished only when it runs. We build the designed operating system on groupware, web, app and POS.
platform.tags: PlanQ groupware · WordPress · Web · App · POS

build.output: Web · App · POS · ERP integration · Dashboards

improve.name: Continuous Improvement
improve.lead: An operating system is never finished in one pass.
improve.desc: We watch real operating data, find the next bottleneck, and keep refining flow and automation.
improve.output: Monthly operations support · Regular reviews · Improvement backlog

process.title: How we work
process.sub: Five stages. It starts with observation and ends in improvement.

s0.title: We observe the company.
s0.desc: We look at the work that actually happens, not the work written in documents. Interviews and work records capture how you work today, as it is.

s1.title: We analyse bottlenecks.
s1.desc: We diagnose along four axes — time, information, roles and workflow — to pinpoint where work stops and where time disappears.

s2.title: We design the new operating system.
s2.desc: Workflows and SOPs, roles and permissions, information structure and the points where AI applies are designed to fit the company.

s3.title: We build the real system.
s3.desc: We implement the design with PlanQ groupware, web, app and AI automation — and stay until the team actually starts using it.

s4.title: We keep improving with operating data.
s4.desc: After rollout we watch the metrics, find the next bottleneck and improve. The operating system grows with the company.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q0: Nothing is organised here at all. Can we still start?
faq.a0: That state is normal. We do not assume an organised company. Observing the unorganised state is exactly where the audit starts. Begin with the work system audit.
faq.q1: Can we take only the design and build it ourselves?
faq.a1: Yes. The design deliverables are your asset and are not locked to a specific tool. We hand them over in a form your own team or another partner can implement directly.
faq.q2: Do we have to throw away the systems we use now?
faq.a2: No. We first look at connecting the ERP, groupware and accounting systems you already use. We propose replacement only when replacing is clearly better.
faq.a3: We start with the work system audit. The design and build quote comes after the audit fixes the scope, so you never have to commit to a large amount up front. Work proceeds under a contract that states scope, schedule and deliverables.

why2.p1title: We do not design and leave.
why2.p1: We build what we designed ourselves, and after it goes live we keep refining it with you, using the data.
